easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
